capabilities: Apply ELK layout to individual Mermaid diagrams using a %% elk %% marker
Route all Mermaid diagrams through ELK via a global setting
Bundle Mermaid 11.17.0 to support newer diagram types like xychart-beta and railroad-beta
Set default look and theme values for routed diagrams
Escape numbered labels that trigger Markdown list rendering inside Mermaid
extras: The listing carries the notice "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." The README warns that a full Obsidian restart is the cleanest reset after changing settings, marks regex overrides as a danger zone for edge cases, and states that debug logging data never leaves the device. Further documentation lives in separate docs files and an examples folder rather than the main README.
intentEvidence: Re-enables the ELK (Eclipse Layout Kernel) layout engine for Mermaid diagrams in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Mermaid uses the older dagre layout and older Mermaid version, so diagrams render with cramped layouts and newer diagram types do not work.

relations.evidence: Can optionally load Mermaid 11.17.0 from the plugin instead of Obsidian's older built-in Mermaid.

summary: Mermaid diagram add-on that re-enables the ELK layout engine and can load Mermaid 11.17.0 for newer diagram types.
